immediate_controls: do not persist the raw OIDC token
do not persist raw artifact bodies
do not register or mutate the package on failed verification
leave merge, phase, commerce, custody and chain paths closed
rollback_sequence: mark the v2 ingest workflow HOLD
disable or redeploy the Edge Function from the last known-good source snapshot
verify function ID, version and build digest
rerun package, ingest and immutable-subject canaries
rerun wrong-signature, wrong-audience, wrong-repository and manifest-drift tests
rerun the GitHub OIDC workflow on the exact current head
record a new append-only correction or replacement receipt
require independent security and evidence review before resume
